hyperedges.label: Everything lowers to one expression IR

nodes.label: Performance vs After Effects
nodes.rationale: 'Faster than AE' is unmeasurable as stated; only narrow controlled claims are worth making.

nodes.label: evaluate(doc, frame) Single Pure Entry Point
nodes.norm_label: evaluate(doc, frame) single pure entry point

nodes.label: Extensibility: Plugin Folder with Manifest
nodes.rationale: One extension system instead of an AE-style SDK; four kinds: filters, nodes, panels/automation, importers/exporters.

nodes.label: Architecture Decision Records Index
nodes.rationale: Accepted ADRs are never edited; superseded by new ones so wrong turns remain instructive.

nodes.label: Undo/Redo as Whole-Document Snapshots
nodes.rationale: Inverse ops force every future feature to implement a correct inverse forever; a missing one silently corrupts. Doc is a plain serializable tree so a snapshot is a cheap clone.

nodes.label: Dock Layout Tree with Deferred Ops
nodes.norm_label: dock layout tree with deferred ops
nodes.rationale: Pure tree rewrites (split/join/retype) are testable; header controls less fragile than egui drag-a-corner.

nodes.label: SVG Track Mattes as Luminance Masks
nodes.norm_label: svg track mattes as luminance masks
nodes.rationale: SVG lacks coverage rules (DestIn/DestOut); offline backend previously skipped mattes silently. Map to luminance masks and report divergences.

nodes.label: Offline CPU Rasterizer with Structural Parity
nodes.norm_label: offline cpu rasterizer with structural parity
nodes.rationale: Headless pixel frames needed in tests/CI/motion render; vello on wgpu needs a GPU. Parity is structural, not per-pixel.

nodes.label: Two Render Buttons: Draft and Master
nodes.norm_label: two render buttons: draft and master
nodes.rationale: Avoid dreaded export dialogs re-answered every time; borrows AE Render Queue's saved settings idea.

nodes.label: Console Panel (Automation API First Surface)
nodes.rationale: Like Blender/Nuke/Maya/Houdini consoles: automation, pipeline adaptation, learning the API; Rhai already in-tree.

nodes.label: Stepped (Not Threaded) GUI Render Job
nodes.rationale: Export must not freeze the editor; work is stepped from the redraw loop.

nodes.label: Audio Is the Master Clock
nodes.rationale: Sound card crystal rate drifts from wall clock (Instant); rate, not latency, is the problem, so derive frame from audio position.

nodes.label: Core Never Touches GPU/Window/File
nodes.rationale: A frame must be evaluatable in a unit test.

nodes.label: Lazy Value<T> Recipe Thesis
nodes.rationale: Animation is a constant, keyframe track or Expr, never a baked result.
